title: Design 3b-1: Home and Discovery, the hero's photos and tabs, stock photo credits, the route colour
why: Jason's directive (design/css-theme-brand.md, Release 3, Home and Explore) and two of his visual fixes (2026-11-17). (1) THE HERO'S ORDER: Let's Explore's hero showed a stock photo before the page's own landmark photos (explore-hero.php checked them after stock), so switching views didn't change it. Now: the page's own and shared photos, then the landmarks' Commons photos (each view its own set), and a stock photo only when there's no real one (decisions/0058 §30, 0138, 0143 §4). Parks passes its place and the subject "national park", Experiences "outdoor experience". (2) STOCK PHOTO CREDITS: the credit on the photo, "Photo: <who> on <source>", with a small i that opens its details (Stock photo, Representative, licence, source); before, only a "Stock photo · Representative" pill. (3) TOKENS: the home page's and Discovery's own styles, the hero's and the stock label's, on the shared tokens; small labels in the icon colour (3.6:1) now in link brown (5:1); the Discovery "Join the team" button white on brand brown (was cream on brass, 2.3:1). FAQ: the stock photo answer describes the credit and the i. (4) THE TABS UNDER THE HERO (Jason, 2026-11-19: "I dont care for the button colors under the hero"): back to light cream with copper icons and the sage bar on the open one; the old gold accent reads as the icon colour across Discovery (tiles, places, the plan's ▾), and "More" is white on brand brown. (5) THE ROUTE COLOUR (Jason, 2026-11-19: "Electric lime for activity like trail"): theme-tokens.php gains --tv-route #B6F22E over a Deep Umber casing (--tv-route-casing), for routes and trails only; no map draws routes yet, so nothing changes on screen. River Blue, Moss and Crimson stay for map features.
